chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Isa ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:

When the fifth from the descendants of the seventh is missing, then Allah, Allah, regarding your religions; let no one remove you from them. O my son, there is inevitably an occultation for the Master of this matter, until one who used to profess this matter turns back from it. It is only a trial from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, by which He has tested His creation. If your fathers and your grandfathers had known a religion more correct than this, they would surely have followed it.

He said: So I said, 'O my master, who is the fifth from the descendants of the seventh?' He said, 'O my son, your intellects are too limited for this, and your forbearance is too constricted to bear it; but if you live, you shall come to realize him.'

key_terms.أَدْيَانِكُمْ: your religion; your committed religious way that must be preserved
key_terms.الْخَامِسُ: the fifth individual being referred to in the Imam's lineage
key_terms.امْتَحَنَ: He tested; Allah's act of trying His creation
key_terms.تُدْرِكُونَهُ: you will realize him or reach his time
key_terms.صَاحِبِ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: the Master of this matter; the divinely designated holder of the affair
key_terms.غَيْبَةٍ: occultation; a period of concealment from public presence
key_terms.مِحْنَةٌ: trial; a divinely decreed test for believers
key_terms.وُلْدِ السَّابِعِ: the descendants of the seventh Imam, indicating a genealogical marker

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kafi say about the occultation of the fifth from the descendants of the seventh Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith foretells the ghaybah (occultation) of the awaited Imam and warns believers to remain firm in their religion during that period of trial. It describes the occultation as a divine test through which some will turn away, while true adherence requires steadfastness and trust in the divinely guided matter of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Isa Bin Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Ja’far, from his father, from his grandfather, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the fifth one from the sons<sup>asws</sup> of the seventh is missing (in Occultation), so Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, with regards to your Religion. Do not let anyone remove you from it, O my<sup>asws</sup> children. An Occultation is inevitable for the Master<sup>asws</sup> of this command, to the extent that he would retract from this matter, the one who used to be saying with it. But rather, it would be an ordeal from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic to Test His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures by it. Had your fathers and your grandfathers known of a Religion more correct that this, they would have followed it’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘So I said, ‘O my Chief<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>! Who is the fifth from the sons<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> of the seventh?’ So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘O my<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> son<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>! Your intellects are too little from this, and your forbearances are too narrow from bearing it, but if you live, so soon you would be realising it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn ‘Isa ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Ja’far from his father from his grandfather from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother, Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“When the fifth descendant of the seventh (Imam) will disappear from the public sight at that time for the sake of Allah, for the sake of Allah protect your religion so no one can strip off of it. My son, it is necessary that the in charge of this task (Leadership with Divine Authority) must disappear from the public sight. Even those who believe in it would turn away from their belief. It will certainly be a trial from Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, to test His creature. Had your fathers and ancestors know any other religion more correct than this they would certainly have followed it.”

I then asked, “My master, who is the fifth from the descendants of the seven?” He said, “My son, you intelligence falls shorter to reach it and your understanding remain narrower to accommodate it but if you would live you will soon comprehend its being.”
